workItem: Implement Evidence to Decision reconciliation for canonical PR template v1.7.
workItemDE: Live-Evidence aus CURRENT_MAIN, Rulesets, Checks, Security, Overlap und Produktions-Baseline in die kanonische PR-Entscheidungsanzeige v1.7 reconciliieren.
priorityReason: Verhindert stale/manuell abweichende PR-Entscheidungsanzeigen und bindet Human/CODEOWNER-Entscheidungen an reproduzierbare Live-Evidence.
exitGate: PR Decision Evidence is deterministically reconciled from exact current main/head, active rulesets, terminal check evidence, exact changed-file overlap and production baseline; stale or missing evidence never becomes PASS.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; automation has no unrestricted merge authority.
